Each platform's related routes and contacts were consolidated into one canonical record.
emailVerificationLevel: demos@yhvmusic.group and demo@vantarecordings.com were first-party published, syntactically valid, domain-aligned and explicitly designated for demos. formVerificationLevel: WHCR uses official show-directed email instructions. VANTA exposes a first-party private-SoundCloud form protected by Google reCAPTCHA. CAPTCHA, embedded fields and submit-time controls remain manual-review boundaries.
safety: No email was sent, no form field was filled, no MP3, CD, private link, WAV or social profile was shared, no consent was accepted, no CAPTCHA was completed, no login or payment was attempted and no submission was performed.
